draft.title: Local, national and global businesses
card: Businesses can be grouped by how far their reach extends. The measure is where their customers and operations are, not how big the business is.
serves customers in one town, suburb or region, such as a bakery in Bathurst.
serves customers across the whole country, often with outlets or online sales in every state and territory.
operates in many countries, selling or making goods and services in more than one nation.
draft.remember: Local is one area, national is the whole country, global is many countries.

a.q: Priya's hair salon has one shop in Orange and serves people from nearby towns. How is it best classified by reach?
a.why: The salon serves one area, so it is local. It is not national, because it does not serve customers across the whole country, even though people travel from nearby towns.
a.clue: Think about how far the salon's customers are spread.

b.q: Harbour Tiles has stores in every Australian state and territory but sells nowhere overseas. Which statement is correct?
opts: It is national, because it serves the whole country only
It is global, because it has many stores
It is local, because each store serves its own suburb
It is national, because it is a large business
b.why: Reach is about where customers are served. Harbour Tiles covers the whole country but no other country, so it is national. Having many stores does not make it global, because it must operate in many countries.
b.clue: Count the countries it sells in, not the stores.

b.best: It is national, because it serves the whole country only

problems.detail: The option 'A multinational business' uses a term the card never defines, so students may be unsure how it differs from 'global'. It is wrong here, but the term is outside what the card teaches.

screen.summary: The answers are correct and the explanations match the card. One option in question a uses 'multinational', which the card does not define, so it may confuse students.

b.best: It is national, because it serves the whole country only
